fact: Doufelgou 1 held a taxpayer census on 4-11 March 2025 with the SIG Recettes application (597 taxpayers, geolocated taxable items, forecast contribution 56.5 million F CFA), validated on 14 March 2025, and Sotouboua 2 validated 991 taxpayers on 13 March 2025, both supported by GIZ ProDeG IV.
title: Décentralisation : Doufelgou 1 et Sotouboua 2 valident leur fichier des contribuables aux recettes non fiscales
